semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides critical infrastructure solutions for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in vibration control and installation services.
summary: Hefei Jiufu Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd specializes in providing high-performance foundation solutions and installation services for semiconductor lithography machines. Their offerings include vibration-proof bases, 3D jig equipment for precise pipeline installation, and laser marking services, ensuring high reliability and efficiency in semiconductor production processes.
capabilities: High-stiffness RC foundation for lithography machines
3D jig technology for hookup pipeline prefabrication

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Hefei, known as the 'IC Capital', and focuses on the semiconductor industry.
